title: Sail Away! Charters- Chesapeake Bay
specs: No passengers who are not feeling well or have a fever
Sailing risk waiver must be signed prior to departure
Private group charters up to 6 passengers (4 preferred)
blurb: Guests book private group charters for sailing on Chesapeake Bay, departing from Kilmarnock, VA. Charters can be half-day or 2-hour durations, with options for sunset sails. Passengers may bring provisions or dine shore-side; no swimming off the boat is allowed.
extraNote: 50% deposit at booking, balance due prior to departure · Cancellation more than 30 days prior: deposit refunded less $35 or transferred · Cancellation 14-30 days prior: deposit transferable but not refundable · Cancellation within 14 days: deposit nonrefundable and nontransferable · Captain may cancel or shorten charter for mechanical or weather reasons with refund or prorated refund · No refunds if passenger cancels or shortens charter in progress · Weather delays, postponements possible; no refunds for passenger cancellations due to weather · Cruises depart from and return to Kilmarnock, VA. Other departure and return points may be arranged.
